cards.card_text: Go glean grain in the fields Find work in the town market Go back home to Moab
cards.verse_text: And Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Please let me go into the fields and glean heads of grain after someone in whose sight I may find favor.” “Go ahead, my daughter,” Naomi replied.
cards.snippet: …Moabitess said to Naomi, “Please let me go into the fields and glean heads of grain after someone in whose sight I may find favor.”…

cards.card_text: So Ruth heads out and gleans after the harvesters.
cards.verse_text: So Ruth departed and went out into the field and gleaned after the harvesters.
cards.snippet: So Ruth departed and went out into the field and gleaned after the harvesters.

cards.card_text: The foreman says Ruth asked to glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.
cards.verse_text: She has said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.’ So she came out and has continued from morning until now, except that she rested a short time in the shelter.”
cards.snippet: She has said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.’ So she came out…

cards.card_text: Boaz tells Ruth not to glean in another ___ and to stay close to his servant girls.
cards.verse_text: Do not go and glean in another field, and do not go away from this place, but stay here close to my servant girls.
cards.snippet: Do not go and glean in another field, and do not go away from this place, but…

cards.card_text: When Ruth gets up to glean again, Boaz turns to his young men with some orders about her.
cards.verse_text: When Ruth got up to glean, Boaz ordered his young men, “Even if she gathers among the sheaves, do not insult her.
cards.snippet: When Ruth got up to glean, Boaz ordered his young men, “Even if she gathers among the sheaves,…

cards.card_text: So Ruth gathers grain in the field until evening, then beats out what she gleaned.
cards.verse_text: And when she beat out what she had gleaned, it was about an ephah of barley.
cards.snippet: And when she beat out what she had gleaned, it was about an ephah of barley.

cards.card_text: Ruth picks up the grain and carries it into town, where Naomi sees what she gleaned.
cards.verse_text: She picked up the grain and went into the town, where her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned.
cards.snippet: …and went into the town, where her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned.

cards.card_text: Naomi has questions: "Where did you glean today, and where did you work?" Friend, I bet that's somebody who wants the WHOLE story, and she wants it NOW.
cards.verse_text: Then her mother-in-law asked her, “Where did you glean today, and where did you work?
cards.snippet: Then her mother-in-law asked her, “Where did you glean today, and where did you work?

cards.card_text: The poor forage for food like wild donkeys in the desert and glean the vineyards of the wicked.
cards.verse_text: They gather fodder in the fields and glean the vineyards of the wicked.
cards.snippet: They gather fodder in the fields and glean the vineyards of the wicked.

cards.card_text: Next the LORD of Hosts reaches for a picture from the vineyard: “Glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly as a vine.”
cards.verse_text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly as a vine.
cards.snippet: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly as a vine.
